name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Stage 6

lat.note: Same point as nextdc-m2 (geocoded 2026-09-27 from '75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine VIC 3043', ArcGIS PointAddress score 100); the stage's own building footprint on the site was not located

mw_it.note: 'Stage 6 of the project will add 8MW of new capacity'; basement, three levels and rooftop plant deck (source 2, snippet). Building/phase within the NEXTDC M2 campus; stage 1 is nextdc-m2; other stages: nextdc-m2-stage2, nextdc-m2-stage4, nextdc-m2-stage5, nextdc-m2-stage6, nextdc-m2-stage9-11.

authority.note: 75 Sharps Rd is in the City of Brimbank (Brimbank register; PlanningAlerts P341/2022), not Hume as earlier assumed

pathway.value: council planning permit (Planning and Environment Act 1987)

reference.note: site data centre permit. Amendment P589/2016 (Pt 5) 'for an extension to a data centre' (received 01/05/2023, amended permit issued 17/01/2024) fits stage 6 timing but the register does not name the stage

lodged.note: candidate: Pt 5 received 2023-05-01 (not confirmed as stage 6)

determined.note: candidate: Pt 5 amended permit issued 2024-01-17 (not confirmed as stage 6)

construction_start.note: Forefront blog (snippet, undated) says the build 'has recently commenced'; date not found

construction_end.note: expected 'by mid-2025' (source 2) / 'in 2025' (Kapitol page, modified Sep 2025, still says 'Currently under construction'). Actual completion not confirmed; by NEXTDC FY26 (to 30 Jun 2026) the only M2 capacity still in progress is the 60MW liquid-cooled expansion (source 6), so stage 6 was presumably complete by then (inference)

open_questions: status: completion not confirmed (expected mid/late 2025; presumed done by 30 Jun 2026)
whether permit amendment P589/2016 (Pt 5, issued 17/01/2024) is the stage 6 approval
